Container.Name: FTB-Skies-2-Aero
Container.Overview: Dedicated server for the FTB Skies 2: Aero modpack (Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge, Java 21), a skyblock pack built around airships. On the first start the container installs the modpack into the appdata folder with the official FTB server installer (about 1.3 GB, takes a few minutes); after that the server starts right away. Set EULA to true to accept the Minecraft EULA. Ops, MOTD, world name and Java memory are set through the variables. To update the modpack, change FTB_VERSION_ID to the ID shown on the FTB versions page.
Container.Requires: About 8 GB of free RAM for the server (JVM_OPTS default -Xms6G -Xmx8G). Players need the same modpack version in the FTB App.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: minecraft modpack ftb feed-the-beast skyblock neoforge airship aeronautics skies aero

Config.Name: EULA
Config.Description: Do you agree to the Mojang EULA available at https://account.mojang.com/documents/minecraft_eula? Server will not start without accepting. Set to 'true' to accept.

Config.Name: OPS
Config.Description: Comma separated list of players to have op capability

Config.Name: LEVEL
Config.Description: Name of the world directory. It is usually world.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the server files

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the server files

Config.Name: FTB_VERSION_ID
Config.Description: FTB modpack version ID (100527 = 1.13.0). Change it to update the modpack on the next start.
